Dataset the baseline is built from (`dataset.dataset_key`); one row per dataset so a CTD-only consumer filters and a cross-dataset one pools weighted by `clim_n` (`sum(clim_mean * clim_n) / sum(clim_n)` is exactly the mean over the pooled observations).
CalCOFI grid cell (`grid.grid_key`). Nearshore cells hold several real stations (`st30-ln90` holds 90.30, 90.28, 90.27.7 and 88.5/30.1), which is why the floor is in cruises.
Calendar month 1–12 of the observations' `datetime`. The anomaly of a cast is its value minus the cell of the cast's own calendar month.
10 m floor bin of `obs.depth_min_m` (`floor(depth_min_m / 10) * 10`, the `obs_env.depth_bin` convention), labelled by its shallow edge; 0–500.
The measured quantity (`measurement_type.measurement_type`); the table's partition column.
Mean of the quality-passing (`cc_qual_ok_sql()`) finite values in the cell over `clim_yr_min`–`clim_yr_max`; in the type's own units.
Sample standard deviation of the same values; NULL when `clim_n` = 1. `anomaly / clim_sd` expresses a departure in baseline standard deviations.
Observations in the cell.
Distinct cruises in the cell; a cell needs at least 3 to exist.
First year of the baseline window (inclusive); stamped on every row so the parquet alone says what the mean is a mean of.
